newsitem.title: HONG KONG: J.Fleming, SHK Prop in JV with Goodwill.
newsitem.headline: J.Fleming, SHK Prop in JV with Goodwill.

text.p: Jardine Fleming Holdings Ltd and Sun Hung Kai Properties Ltd said on Tuesday they would each take a 30 percent stake in the financial services businesses of Goodwill Investment (Holdings) Ltd.
Goodwill would retain a 40 percent interest in the venture, a statement from the three companies said. Financial details were not disclosed.
A new company, Goodwill Financial Services (Holdings) Ltd, would be formed under the agreement and would be led by Goodwill Investment chairman K.B. Fung, the companies said.
The businesses concerned are securities broking and related activities -- capital raising, equity investment, corporate finance and some fund management, they said.
The new company brought together Goodwill's retail business and local client base, SHK Prop's strength in the Hong Kong market and Jardine Fleming's regional expertise, they said.

Through the new company, issuers of shares would be able to have access to retail and institutional investors in Hong Kong, throughout the Asia-Pacific region and in major international capital markets, they added.

Goodwill Investment is a financial services and property investment and development firm. SHK Prop is a property investor and developer. Jardine Fleming is a securities joint venture between Jardine Matheson group and Robert Fleming group.
